title: 第一卷 第17章 丹药坊风波第一卷 第18章 胯下羞辱
lines: 除了境界上的提升之外，秦玄的身体素质也有了不小的提升。
虽然没法和第一次的炼神鼎熔炼相提并论，可提升也是足够巨大的。
秦玄看了眼自己那双莹白如玉的手，微微点头。
这些本源灵液对他的帮助可是不小。
“可惜了，那玉清境的尸体精华已经消失了不少，不然一定可以让我的肉身更上一层台阶。”
“不过这样也足够了。”
秦玄思索着。
“接下来，可以炼制一些丹药了，要想提升实力，除了这些灵液之外，还需要更多的丹药”
被女帝‘虐待’的三百年里，女帝为了让他更快恢复身体，可是教过他炼制丹药。
“更何况，这炼神鼎可是最顶级的炼丹鼎。”
当年在得知炼神鼎可以炼制丹药后，秦玄也是无比震惊。
“炼神鼎还能炼制丹药？”
秦玄还以为这炼神鼎只能用来毁尸灭迹。
“小子，你那是什么眼神？，你不会以为我只会杀人放火吧？”
当时的璇玑女帝为此很是不满。
“炼神鼎可以炼人，炼神，当然炼丹、炼器。炼神鼎可比你想的强大得多。”
想到这里，秦玄随即便开始寻找合适的丹方。
女帝留给他的信息中自然包含不少丹方。
很快，秦玄便找到了合适的丹方，只是这里面的药材他手头并没有。。
思前想后，秦玄眼前一亮。
“是了，明天可以去城中秦家的坊市看看。”
到了第二天，秦玄离开秦家赶往城中坊市。
秦家作为火风城第一家族，除了武力之外，自然也有不少产业。
而这些产业中，最大的便是丹药铺子。
整个火风城全城，秦家一共六座丹药铺子，其中五座只是用来销售现成的丹药。
唯有处于城中最好地段的一座丹药坊请了一位炼丹大师来炼制丹药，秦家九成的丹药都是出自这位炼丹大师的手笔。
因此，秦玄直接朝着秦家最大的这丹药坊赶了过去。
小半个时辰后，秦玄便赶到家族的丹药坊。
几个看门的秦家侍卫看到秦玄走了过来，急忙迎了上来。
“见过少族长，不知道少族长有什么吩咐？”
听着这话，秦玄沉吟片刻之后便拿出了一份列着药材的清单。
“你们帮我准备下这些药材吧？”
听到这里，这些侍卫顿时面面相觑，沉吟片刻，其中一个侍卫硬着头皮朝秦玄拱了拱手。
content_en:
In addition to the improvement in realm, Qin Xuan's physical fitness has also improved a lot.
Although it cannot be compared with the first smelting of the God Refining Cauldron, the improvement is still huge enough.
Qin Xuan glanced at his hands, which were as white as jade, and nodded slightly.
These original spiritual fluids were of great help to him.
"It's a pity that a lot of the corpse essence in the Jade Clear Realm has disappeared, otherwise it would definitely be able to take my physical body to a higher level."
"But this is enough."
Qin Xuan thought.
"Next, we can refine some elixirs. If we want to improve our strength, in addition to these spiritual liquids, we also need more elixirs."
During the three hundred years of being 'abused' by the Empress, the Empress taught him how to refine elixirs in order to help him recover faster.
"What's more, this divine refining cauldron is the top alchemy cauldron."
When he learned that the Divine Refining Cauldron could refine elixirs, Qin Xuan was extremely shocked.
"Can the Divine Refining Cauldron also refine elixirs?"
Qin Xuan thought that this divine refining cauldron could only be used to destroy corpses and eliminate traces.
"Boy, what's that look in your eyes? You don't think I only know how to kill people and set fires, do you?"
The Empress Xuanji at that time was very dissatisfied with this.
"The God-Refining Cauldron can refine people, gods, and of course elixirs and weapons. The God-Refining Cauldron is much more powerful than you think."
Thinking of this, Qin Xuan immediately started looking for a suitable elixir.
The message the empress left for him naturally contained many prescriptions for elixirs.
Soon, Qin Xuan found a suitable elixir, but he didn't have the medicinal materials in it. .
After thinking about it, Qin Xuan's eyes lit up.
"Yes, you can go to the Qin family's market in the city tomorrow."
On the next day, Qin Xuan left the Qin family and rushed to Zhongfang City.
As the number one family in Huofeng City, the Qin family naturally has many industries in addition to military force.
Among these industries, the largest is the elixir shop.
In the entire Huofeng City, the Qin family has a total of six elixir shops, five of which are only used to sell ready-made elixirs.
Only an elixir shop located in the best part of the city hired an alchemy master to refine elixirs. Ninety percent of the Qin family's elixirs were made by this alchemy master.
Therefore, Qin Xuan rushed directly towards the largest pill shop in the Qin family.
Less than half an hour later, Qin Xuan rushed to the family's elixir shop.
Several guards of the Qin family who were guarding the door saw Qin Xuan approaching and hurriedly came to greet him.
"I've met the young patriarch. I wonder what the young patriarch's instructions are?"
After hearing this, Qin Xuan pondered for a moment and then took out a list of medicinal materials.
"Can you help me prepare these medicinal materials?"
Hearing this, the guards immediately looked at each other and pondered for a moment. One of the guards gritted his teeth and raised his hand to Qin Xuan.
